faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.sub: Answers to the most common questions before you get started.
faq.q0: What AI models does Daya use?
faq.a0: Daya works with the best open models: DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba), GLM (Z.ai), Kimi (Moonshot), and MiniMax. It automatically picks the most suitable one for each task based on complexity and cost.
faq.q1: Are my documents and data safe?
faq.a1: Yes. Your documents are stored encrypted and are never used to train third-party models. You can delete all your content from Settings → Data at any time.
faq.q2: Can I cancel whenever I want?
faq.a2: Absolutely. No contracts, no commitments. Cancel your subscription at any time from Settings → Plan and you won't be charged the next cycle.
faq.q3: What's included in the free plan?
faq.a3: The free plan includes 15 messages per day, access to basic models, web search, and basic memory. No credit card required to get started.
faq.q4: How is it different from ChatGPT or Claude directly?
faq.a4: Daya combines multiple models instead of locking you into one, adds real-time web search, persistent memory between conversations, and works with your documents — all from a single unified interface.

about.title: About Daya AI
about.p1: Daya AI was born from a simple idea: AI shouldn't require you to know which model to use, when to search the web, or how to craft the perfect prompt. It should simply understand you and choose the best tool for each task.
about.p2: We're a small team that believes artificial intelligence should be accessible, private, and genuinely useful — not just impressive in demos. That's why we built Daya: an assistant that works with you, not the other way around.
about.p3: Our mission is to democratize access to the best AI models, combining DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in a single fluid interface that learns from you and protects your information.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s0Content: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device to remember information about your visit, such as language preferences or session state.
cookies.s1Content: We use three types: (1) Essential cookies, required for the service to work (authentication, session). These cannot be disabled. (2) Preference cookies, which remember your settings (theme, language). (3) Analytics cookies, only with your consent, to understand how Daya is used and improve the service.
cookies.s2Content: We don't use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. The only possible third-party cookies are from our technical providers (Supabase for sessions, Vercel for performance).
cookies.s3Content: You can control analytics cookies from the cookie banner that appears the first time you visit Daya. You can also configure your browser to block or delete cookies, though this may affect how the service functions.
cookies.s4Content: If we update this cookie policy, we'll let you know via the cookie banner or by email if you have an account. The last updated date always appears below.
cookies.s5Content: For questions about our use of cookies, write to us at privacidad@daya-ai.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s0Content: We collect: your name and email when you register, the conversations and documents you generate, your preferences and settings, and technical usage data (device type, language) to operate and improve the service.
privacy.s1Content: We process your data on the following bases: contract performance (providing the service you requested), your consent (analytics cookies, communications), and our legitimate interest (security and service improvement). You can withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.s2Content: We use your data to: provide and improve the service, personalize your experience, process payments, and send you important communications about your account.
privacy.s3Content: We never sell your data. To operate, we share the minimum necessary with our providers (sub-processors): Supabase (database), OpenRouter (AI processing), Resend (email delivery), and our payment gateway. Each processes data under their own guarantees.
privacy.s4Content: Some of our providers process data outside your country. In those cases we rely on recognized safeguards (such as standard contractual clauses) to protect your information.
privacy.s5Title: How long we keep your data
privacy.s5Content: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we permanently erase your data. Some minimal records may be retained if required by law.
privacy.s6Content: We use encryption in transit and at rest, hashed passwords (bcrypt), limited data access, and security best practices to protect your information.
privacy.s7Content: You have the right to access, correct, export, and delete your data. You can download all your data or delete your account directly from Settings → Security. If you reside in the EU (GDPR) or California (CCPA), you also have the right to object to processing and to file a complaint with your data protection authority.
privacy.s8Content: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and, only with your consent, analytics cookies to improve the service. You can manage your choice in the cookie banner. We don't use third-party advertising cookies.
privacy.s9Content: The service is not directed at individuals below the minimum legal age in your country. We don't knowingly collect data from minors without parental consent.
privacy.s10Content: We'll notify you by email about significant changes to this policy with reasonable advance notice.
privacy.s11Content: To exercise your privacy rights or make inquiries, write to us at privacidad@daya-ai.com.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.s0Content: By accessing Daya AI you accept these terms. If you disagree, please do not use the service. We reserve the right to update them at any time.
terms.s1Content: Daya AI is an artificial intelligence platform with access to multiple models, personalized memory, and document and image generation.
terms.s2Content: You may only use Daya AI for lawful purposes. Generating harmful, misleading, or third-party rights-infringing content is prohibited. We may suspend accounts that violate these policies.
terms.s3Content: We collect data necessary to operate the service. We never sell it. You can delete your data from Settings at any time.
terms.s4Content: By using Daya AI you agree that conversations may be used anonymously to improve the service. You can disable this from your privacy settings.
terms.s5Content: The content you generate is yours. Daya AI retains the right to use anonymized data to improve its models. The platform and its technology are the property of Daya AI.
terms.s6Content: Daya AI does not guarantee the accuracy of responses. The service is provided as-is. We are not responsible for decisions made based on generated content.
terms.s7Content: Plans are billed monthly. You can cancel at any time. Prices may change with 30 days' notice.
terms.s8Content: For legal inquiries write to us at legal@daya-ai.com. We respond within 5 business days.
